name: io.github.janahayaly/scorax
title: Scorax
description: ESG scores for S&P 100 companies from public EPA, OSHA and DOJ data, with sources and rankings.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find S&P 100 companies by ticker or name. Returns ticker, sector, overall Scorax score and a link.

query.description: Ticker or part of a company name, e.g. "XOM" or "Exxon". Empty lists all.

tools.name: get_company_scores
tools.description: Scorax scores for one company: overall, environmental and social (0-5), each GRI standard with its year, and how many standards are reported vs sector estimates.

company.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. "WMT" or "Walmart"

tools.name: get_score_details
tools.description: How one GRI standard score was calculated for a company: indicator values, peer benchmarks, score per indicator, data sources with links, and whether it is a sector estimate.

tools.name: compare_companies
tools.description: Side-by-side Scorax scores and per-standard results for two companies.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: Top or bottom S&P 100 companies overall, by category, or on one GRI standard. Rankings exclude companies with too little reported data and never rank sector estimates.

scope.description: "overall" (default), "environmental", "social", or a GRI code such as "305" (emissions) or "403" (worker safety)

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Recent ESG-relevant news headlines about S&P 100 companies, classified by GRI topic, sentiment and severity. AI-classified; separate from scores.

company.description: Ticker to filter by, e.g. "BA". Omit for all companies.
